verdict.rationale: Alloy is a KYC/AML decisioning platform, so configurable name-matching for watchlist screening is a fair question for this kind of product. The evidence only mentions AML checks in general and webhooks for watchlist updates. Nothing documents configuring name-matching thresholds or logic, or inspecting alias or transliteration matches.

support.subject: As a risk-analyst, I can configure name matching and inspect alias or transliteration matches
